item.title: Prithvi
item.description: Hey there! I’m Prithvi, a Moderator at Pthoth Labs. I keep an eye on our social media presence and, more broadly, on how things are moving across the team as a whole. I enjoy staying in the loop on everything — spotting where a nudge or a fix is needed and making sure nothing slips through the cracks. 🛠️

item.title: Vighnesh Nilajakar
item.description: Hi! I’m Vighnesh Nilajakar, a Moderator at Pthoth Labs. I oversee coordination across all our teams — social media, IT, our educators, and everything in between. I like having a wide view of how the club runs and making sure every part of it is working well together. 🧭

item.title: Naman Bhute
item.description: Hey! I’m Naman Bhute, a Moderator at Pthoth Labs, focused on IT and the technical side of things. I help keep our systems, tools, and technical setup reliable and running smoothly. I’m interested in technology, problem-solving, and exploring new ways to make things work better. 🚀

item.title: Vinit Lohar
item.description: Hey! I’m Vinit Lohar, Point of Contact Manager at Pthoth Labs. I help keep communication clear across the team, making sure updates, questions, and coordination don’t fall through the cracks. I like being the reliable link that keeps everyone connected. 🔗

item.title: Rakshita Pawar
item.description: Hey! I’m Rakshita Pawar, Social Media Manager at Pthoth Labs. I handle how the club shows up online — planning posts, keeping our socials active, and making sure our work reaches the right audience. I enjoy the mix of creativity and strategy that comes with it. 📱🌟

item.title: Ummehabiba Akeelahmed Kotwal
item.description: Hey there! I’m Ummehabiba Akeelahmed Kotwal, IT Manager at Pthoth Labs. I look after the tech backbone of the team — keeping systems running smoothly and making sure everyone has what they need to build without friction. I enjoy troubleshooting, organizing infrastructure, and being the person people can count on when something needs fixing. 🖥️

item.title: Varshini Gudigar
item.description: Hi there! I’m Varshini Gudigar, Point of Contact Manager at Pthoth Labs. I’m often the bridge between people — coordinating communication, keeping things organized, and making sure everyone stays on the same page. I enjoy being the one who helps things run smoothly behind the scenes. 🤝

item.title: Pavitra Madiwal
item.description: Hi! I’m Pavitra Madiwal, Content Creator at Pthoth Labs. I love turning ideas into words and visuals that actually connect with people. Whether it’s a post, a caption, or a story about what we’re building, I enjoy finding the right way to tell it. 📝✨

item.title: Sneha
item.description: Hey! I’m Sneha, part of the Research and Development team at Pthoth Labs. I like exploring new concepts and testing what actually works before it becomes part of a bigger project. Curiosity is basically my job description. 🔍

item.title: Tazeen Maldar
item.description: Hi! I’m Tazeen Maldar, part of the Research and Development team at Pthoth Labs. I enjoy digging into new tools, technologies, and ideas before they make it into our projects. There’s something exciting about being the first to explore what’s next. 🔬

item.title: Nandini Dasar
item.description: Hi there! I’m Nandini Dasar, part of the Research and Development team at Pthoth Labs. I enjoy the early-stage part of a project — researching, experimenting, and figuring out the best way forward before things take shape. 🧪

item.title: Naqeeda
item.description: Hey! I’m Naqeeda, part of the Research and Development team at Pthoth Labs. I like getting into the details of a new idea or tool, understanding how it works, and figuring out how it fits into what we’re building. 💡

item.title: Zaveriya Baig
item.description: Hey there! I’m Zaveriya Baig, an Educator at Pthoth Labs. I like making tech feel less intimidating — explaining ideas clearly and helping others build confidence as they learn. 📚
